# Boardly

Boardly is an enterprise project and sprint management app: team boards,
sprints, chat, calendars, and billing.

- Product: https://trello-dashboard-sepia.vercel.app/
- Public pages: /login, /signup, /pricing
- The app itself requires sign-in; boards, chat, and admin routes are
  authenticated and intentionally not crawlable (see robots.txt).
